name: Strawberry
description: Sparkle EdDSA on macOS, qtsparkle on Windows — payload signed vs pinned key. No Linux in-app updater.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: In the reviewed Strawberry snapshot, macOS metadata configures a Sparkle feed and SUPublicEDKey, while CMake conditionally enables Sparkle on Apple and QtSparkle on Apple or Windows. The inspected source does not establish a Linux in-app updater through these components; other release mechanisms remain outside this review.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot rather than the original study release; Linux packaging and any non-Sparkle update behavior, release artifacts, and delegated framework enforcement were not independently verified.

trust_root: Sparkle key pinned in Info.plist (mac) / qtsparkle (Win)
